statements.t: We anticipate just one of these pilots, if successful, will yield approximately $7 million in revenue in 2027.

In Federal, we have a verbal win for a contract valued at $5 million per year for five years, which we expect to sign by the end of the fourth quarter; it would be the third program our Federal practice has won through our prime partners in its first year.

“With this momentum, we are raising our full-year 2026 revenue growth guidance to 42% or more year-over-year, up from 40% or more, even after absorbing the wind-down of a program at one of our large customers that we expect to be replaced by new programs in Q1.

We believe we are positioned at the center of the most important transition in AI – the move to agents, reinforcement learning and embodied intelligence – and of the trust and safety work that we believe will be required to make the transition succeed.
